list.title: API keys
list.description: Systems that call the API with a key. A key is shown once, when it is made.

create.title: New API client
create.description: Its first key is shown once, after you create it.
create.name: Name
create.quotaHint: Requests a day (UTC); past it, the API answers 429. Leave empty for none.
create.quotaInvalid: A whole number of 1 or more.

secret.warning: You won't see this key again. Copy it now and keep it somewhere safe.
secret.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the key and copy it by hand.
secret.label: API key

quota.title: Daily quota
quota.description: Requests a day (UTC). Past it, the API answers 429 quota_exceeded until midnight UTC.
quota.label: Requests a day

allowlist.title: IP allowlist
allowlist.description: The addresses this client's keys may be used from: one IPv4 or IPv6 address or CIDR range per line (203.0.113.0/24, 2001:db8::/32). A request from elsewhere is refused with 403 client_ip_not_allowed. Leave empty to allow any address.
allowlist.label: Allowed addresses
allowlist.invalid: Line {{line}}: “{{value}}” is not an IPv4 or IPv6 address or CIDR range.
allowlist.prefix: Line {{line}}: “{{value}}” has a prefix length outside 0-{{max}}.

state.title: Access
state.activeDescription: While revoked, every key of this client is refused.
state.revokeDescription: Every key of this client stops working from the next request. You can reactivate it later.
state.deleteDescription: Its keys stop working at once, and its roles, usage and webhook endpoints are deleted with it. This can't be undone: to stop it and keep it, revoke it instead.

keys.title: Keys
keys.revokeDescription: The key {{keyId}} stops working now. A system using it is refused.

rotate.title: Rotate the key
rotate.description: Makes a new key. The current ones keep working for the grace period, so the system can switch.
rotate.confirmDescription: A new key is made and shown once. The current keys stop working after the grace period you chose.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: What this client may do on top of what every API client may. You can only give roles whose permissions you hold.

usage.title: API usage
usage.description: Requests of an API client per UTC day and route.

stats.overQuota: Quota reached: requests are refused until midnight UTC
